one_line: Opposing commanders at the 1799 siege of Seringapatam in the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War.

appearance.age_look: Both appear in their early 40s, athletic and battle-hardened, with upright military posture.
appearance.face: Tipu has an oval face, medium-brown Mysorean complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed moustache, intense large eyes with a focused, wary gaze; Harris has a long face, fair British complexion with slight weathering, straight nose, thin lips, and calm but firm eyes, both usually shown with serious, determined expressions.
appearance.hair: Tipu’s hair is fully covered by a cream-coloured, close-wrapped Mysore-style turban with a dark green band and a small central jewelled brooch at the front; Harris has powdered light-brown hair tied back in a short queue, mostly hidden under a black bicorne hat edged in gold trim, worn slightly tilted.
appearance.costume: Tipu wears a long, knee-length striped jama in off-white with narrow dark-green vertical stripes, crossed left over right and tied with a broad dark-green cotton sash at the waist, over loose off-white churidar trousers and brown leather shoes; over the jama he wears a fitted, slightly quilted dark-green cotton war coat (loosely based on Mysore military tunics) reaching mid-thigh with simple round brass buttons, no ornate embroidery, and a plain dark-green wool shawl draped over one shoulder for campaigning; Harris wears a late-18th-century British general’s double-breasted red wool coat with dark navy lapels and cuffs, gold braid and buttons, long coattails, and a white waistcoat and white breeches tucked into black riding boots, with a dark navy sash around his waist and a simple white cravat at the neck.
appearance.signature: Tipu carries a slightly curved Mysorean sabre with a steel blade, a simple brass hilt and disc pommel, and a plain dark-brown scabbard, held or worn at his left hip; Harris carries a straight British officer’s smallsword with a steel blade and gilt guard sheathed at his left side, and often holds a rolled campaign map or dispatch in his left hand.

ref_desc: Tipu Sultan and George Harris stand side by side: Tipu in a cream-and-dark-green striped jama, dark-green turban and war coat with brown shoes, gripping a curved Mysorean sabre, and Harris in a red and navy gold-trimmed British general’s coat with bicorne hat and straight smallsword, using a dark green, off-white, red, navy and gold palette.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of two opposing commanders from 1799 Mysore, shown together for consistent design: Tipu Sultan on the left and George Harris on the right. Tipu has an oval face, medium-brown Mysorean complexion, sharp nose, neat moustache and large intense eyes, with a serious, wary expression. His hair is covered by a cream close-wrapped Mysore-style turban with a dark green band and a small central jewelled brooch. He wears a knee-length off-white jama with narrow dark-green vertical stripes, crossed left over right and tied with a broad dark-green sash, over loose off-white churidar trousers and brown leather shoes. Over this is a fitted, slightly quilted dark-green cotton war coat to mid-thigh with simple round brass buttons and no ornate embroidery, plus a plain dark-green wool shawl over one shoulder. At his left hip hangs a slightly curved Mysorean sabre with steel blade, simple brass hilt and disc pommel, in a dark-brown scabbard, sometimes drawn and held in his right hand. Beside him, George Harris has a long face, fair British complexion with subtle weathering, straight nose and calm but firm eyes, wearing a composed, determined expression. He has powdered light-brown hair tied in a short queue under a black bicorne hat edged in gold. His costume is a late-18th-century British general’s double-breasted red wool coat with dark navy lapels and cuffs, gold braid and buttons and long coattails, a white waistcoat, white breeches and black riding boots, with a dark navy sash at the waist and a simple white cravat. At his left side is a straight British officer’s smallsword with a steel blade and gilt guard, and in his left hand he often holds a rolled campaign map or dispatch. Use a restrained palette of dark green, off-white, red, navy blue and gold, and show front, three-quarter and back views, focusing on the fixed face shapes, hair, headgear, coats, sashes, weapons and overall proportions in a dynamic but historically grounded shonen-anime style.
